decisions.reason: As a newly launched line close to the core range and given dedicated website presentation, it likely meets or is close enough to aspiration levels to justify continued support despite the firm's limited slack.

The serum fits the firm's established natural facial-care capabilities and should be retained unless clear underperformance emerges, though its lower visibility suggests somewhat less commitment than Product A.

The cleansing milk is also an incremental extension of the existing offer, so boundedly rational management would usually keep it for now, but a small firm may reallocate resources if early sales fall short of aspirations.
